questions.question: What is the certainty effect under Prospect theory?
questions.solution_html:

  • more confident in outcomes that are certain, as opposed to outcomes that are less certain. It is a
  • behavioral model that is part of prospect theory, a theory that emphasizes how people prefer
  • small, guaranteed outcomes over larger, riskier outcomes. Value Liberally (Hint: Give maximum

questions.question: Define PACED Model.
questions.solution_html:
• The PACED decision-making model is a structured approach to making decisions that helps
  • individuals evaluate their options based on specific criteria. It includes five steps that make
  • up its acronym PACED. The letters stand for problem, alternatives, criteria, evaluation, and
  • decision.

questions.question: Define cognitive biases and explain their relevance in financial and / economic decision-making.
questions.solution_html:
• Cognitive bias can be defined as a mental error affecting how we think and process
  • information, leading to an irrational decision. It significantly influence financial decision
  • making by altering perceptions, distorting risk assessments, and leading to suboptimal
  • investment outcomes. Common biases such as overconfidence, anchoring, loss aversion
  • herd behavior, and confirmation bias affect how individuals evaluate financial information
  • and make investment choices
questions.final_answer: and make investment choices
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025
